title: A Guide to Cutting Costs with Heat Pumps | Rewiring America
summary: Rewiring America guide: average households save by switching, most from oil, propane or resistance; little on average from gas.

assertions.quote: For most American homeowners, one of the best ways to save money and energy is to switch to an electric heat pump
these heating and cooling machines are anywhere between 2-4x more efficient than traditional furnaces and boilers.
the biggest savings will come if you switch from fuel oil, propane, or electricity as your main source of heat.
Because of current prices, switching to a heat pump from natural gas doesn’t save much on average.
Heat pumps work in both warm and cold climates.
If your home is poorly insulated then you probably spend a lot of money to heat and/or cool your home. And that means more opportunity
Heat pumps also require less maintenance than combustion heating systems, which means lower repair and maintenance costs.
